title: Tamper Guard (website + admin/POS)
subtitle: Blocks right-click, F12, Ctrl+Shift+I / J / C, Ctrl+U and Ctrl+S, watches for open developer tools, and logs every attempt here as a CRITICAL event with user, IP, page and time. Super Admins see each one in Notifications.
blocked: This action is turned off in NST.
load_failed: Tamper guard settings could not be loaded.
limits: A browser can never be locked 100%: a skilled person can still open developer tools. The real protection is on the server: prices, discounts, amounts and permissions are checked again on every order and sale, and a changed request is stopped and logged as a CRITICAL event.

help.enabled: Master switch. Off = nothing is blocked or logged.
help.website: Storefront, customer portal and supplier portal.
help.admin: Every admin and POS screen, including the login page.
help.detect_devtools: Logs an event when developer tools are opened next to the page (desktop browsers).
help.whitelist_super_admin: Signed-in Super Admins can use right-click and developer tools, and their actions are not logged.
